create_render_context: create a render context on device with configurable camera resolution, RGB, depth, and segmentation rendering
build_data_device: build a data object on device from a MuJoCo model with configurable nworld, nconmax, and njmax parameters
put_model_device: put a MuJoCo model onto the GPU device with feature validation and sparse Jacobian detection
get_data_host: get simulation data from the GPU device into an existing MuJoCo MjData host object
override_model_params: override model parameters such as opt.iterations, opt.cone, and opt.disableflags with string or typed values
